SaaS Founders Club: posting guide

We are a community of bootstrapped and funded SaaS founders.

  1. Self-promotion is welcome in every category, just be transparent that it is your product.
  2. Feel free to include links to your landing page.
  3. Scheduled posts from tools like Buffer are fine.
  4. You can post twice a day at most.

Be generous with feedback.
